sources.title: Luma laboratory east
sources.text: Under workload Z and version 4, Method C had worst-case latency of 40 milliseconds. Method D had worst-case latency of 60 milliseconds.

sources.title: Luma laboratory west
sources.text: Under the same workload Z and version 4, Method C had worst-case latency of 80 milliseconds. Method D again had worst-case latency of 60 milliseconds. The difference for Method C remains unresolved.

tasks.question: For workload Z and version 4, is Method D established below 70 milliseconds? Choose D or abstain.
For workload Z and version 4, is Method C established below 50 milliseconds? Choose C or abstain.

sources.title: Noma deployment manual
sources.text: Method E runs locally without a network and requires at least 12 GB of available RAM. Method F is cloud-only and cannot run locally. Both statements are requirements, not benchmark measurements.

tasks.question: The data must remain local, no network is allowed, and only 8 GB RAM is available. Choose E or F only if every constraint is met.
The data must remain local, no network is allowed, and 16 GB RAM is available. Choose a supported method.

sources.title: Sora device comparison
sources.text: Method G was measured at 12 hours of battery life. Method H was measured at 18 hours. The comparison does not report whether either device is waterproof.

tasks.question: Choose a method with verified waterproof operation based only on the supplied report.
Choose a method measured at no less than 15 hours of battery life.

sources.title: Tero evaluation scope
sources.text: Method I reached 92 percent accuracy on still photos. Method I was not evaluated on video, so this report makes no video-accuracy claim. Method J reached 85 percent accuracy on video in the same evaluation.

tasks.question: For video, choose a method with reported accuracy of at least 80 percent.
Does the report establish Method I at 90 percent accuracy on video? Choose I or abstain.

sources.title: Vero version 1 guide
sources.text: In version 1, Method K exports transparent PNG. This statement applies only to version 1.

sources.title: Vero version 2 guide
sources.text: In version 2, Method K exports opaque PNG only, while Method L exports transparent PNG.

tasks.question: The system runs version 2 and requires transparent PNG. Choose a supported method.
The system is fixed to version 1. Is Method K supported for transparent PNG? Choose K or abstain.

sources.title: Aster test alpha
sources.text: For batch B and version 2, Method M processed 100 items per second. Method N processed 120 items per second.

sources.title: Aster test beta
sources.text: For the same batch B and version 2, Method M processed 140 items per second. Method N processed 120 items per second. No adjudication exists for the Method M disagreement.

tasks.question: For batch B and version 2, is Method N established at no less than 110 items per second? Choose N or abstain.
For batch B and version 2, is Method M established at no less than 110 items per second? Choose M or abstain.
